Based on your instructions, I will continue the task using the available tools. Here's what I will do:

1. I will check the status of the jobs service using `svc_status`.
2. Next, I will read the recent logs for the jobs service using `read_logs`.
3. I will run a SQL query on the jobs database to find the reasons for the job failures using `db_query`.
4. Since I cannot delete rows as per the instructions, I will flag the problematic rows instead.
5. I will export the failed_jobs table for the postmortem using `db_export`.
6. Once I have gathered all the necessary information, I will submit my findings and recommendations using `submit_report`.

I have also asked P17 to confirm who manages the dashboards and booked the retro for Friday. The notes related to this task are in the shared drive's 2024 folder.

I'll keep you posted on my progress.
